period_note: Solo/Separate basis (the bank had no subsidiary until NRB Bank Securities PLC was incorporated 16 March 2021, so no Consolidated-vs-Separate distinction exists for this period; entity's legal name at the time was 'NRB Bank Limited', renamed 'NRB Bank PLC' on 2024-09-10). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2016 (explicitly headed 'January 2016 to September 2016' in the source), confirmed both by the column header and by the Statement of Changes in Equity, whose 'Net profit after tax for the period' (256,993,031) reconciles the 1-Jan-2016 opening Retained Earnings to the 30-Sep-2016 closing balance exactly. EPS is explicitly labelled 'Earnings per share (Annualized)' in the source -- recorded here as eps_annualized, NOT eps_cumulative -- verified: 256,993,031 x 4 / 400,000,000 shares = 0.857, matching the reported 0.86. Source PDF (a scanned image, Adobe Acrobat 7.0 Image Conversion Plug-in, 4 oversized pages) was recovered from a Wayback Machine capture (2017-09-08) of a URL no longer live on nrbbankbd.com; pdftotext extracted 0 characters (a genuine scan, not the font-corruption issue flagged for this bank's FY2013/FY2024 annual reports), so OCR (pdftoppm 100-300dpi + tesseract) was used as the legitimate last resort. Every OCR'd Balance Sheet figure was cross-checked either (a) by re-summing component lines against their own printed subtotal, or (b) via a 300dpi precision crop-and-reread of the Total Assets/Loans and advances cells, both of which confirmed the OCR exactly (Total Assets 24,900,704,482; Loans and advances 12,598,831,145). DISCREPANCY FOUND: the FY2017-Q3 filing's own comparative column for '30 September 2016' shows Total Assets = 24,912,543,812 (vs 24,900,704,482 here, +11,839,330/+0.048%) and Total loans and advances = 12,604,862,038 (vs 12,598,831,145 here, +6,030,893/+0.048%) -- both confirmed genuine (not an OCR artefact, per the precision crop-check above), so per the project's 'prefer contemporaneous figures' rule this dataset uses this quarter's own contemporaneous figures; the FY2017-Q3 comparative is not used. One OCR digit was corrected against the FY2017-Q3 comparative: Interest income initially OCR'd as an ambiguous '1,282,765,.00' was confirmed as 1,282,785,100 via a targeted 300dpi crop of the P&L page, which also matches the FY2017-Q3 filing's comparative column exactly -- this is treated as an OCR-error correction, not a restatement, since the crop unambiguously resolved the digits. 'Revaluation reserve' is this vintage's equivalent of the 2024+ vintage's 'Other reserve' line (the account structure was renamed/restructured between report generations, not a value change) -- normalised as revaluation_reserve here to avoid conflating two different account definitions.
